name: Enju
source:
A boy who has a fallen aura.
He at first gives a silent and cold impression, but is thoughtful and very kind at heart.
He seems to not be a native of this kingdom.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092288.html]DLsite English[/url]]
